chunks: Kulayb ibn Mu'āwiyah heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:
Whoever kills during a sacred month is liable for a blood money and one-third more.

key_terms.دِيَةٌ: blood money; the prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing
key_terms.شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ: a sacred month in which violations carry greater legal gravity
key_terms.وَثُلُثٌ: an additional one-third added to the standard blood money

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money ruling for killing in a sacred month?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on homicide committed during one of the sacred months. It states that the prescribed blood money (diyyah) is increased by one-third in recognition of the added sanctity of that time.
